column2: Tuple giving the size of each axis, e.g. (genes, samples) = (20530, 576). Print it after every load, transpose and reshape.
axis=0 reduces down the rows (one result per column); axis=1 reduces across columns (one result per row).
NumPy's rule for combining arrays of different shapes: align shapes from the right; each pair of dims must be equal or one of them 1. Size-1 dims are virtually stretched.
Keeps the reduced axis as size 1, e.g. (G,S).mean(axis=1, keepdims=True) -> (G,1), so the result broadcasts back over the samples.
On a square matrix, X - X.mean(axis=1) subtracts row means column-wise without any error. Always use keepdims or check shapes.
Replacing Python loops with whole-array operations executed in compiled code; typically 10-100x faster.
z = (x - mean) / SD; puts each gene on a unit-free scale with mean 0 and SD 1.
'Delta degrees of freedom' in the SD denominator (N - ddof). NumPy and StandardScaler use 0; pandas .std() defaults to 1.
Standardizes columns (features). For a genes x samples matrix, transpose to samples x genes first.
(x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD); less sensitive to outlier samples than mean/SD.
Each variable is a column, each observation a row, each type of observational unit its own table.
Wide: one row per sample, one column per gene. Long: one row per (sample, gene, value). pandas melt goes wide->long; pivot goes long->wide.
pandas check on join cardinality, e.g. validate='one_to_one' raises if either key is duplicated.
Adds a _merge column (both / left_only / right_only) to show where each row came from.
First 12 characters of the barcode, e.g. TCGA-05-4244. One patient can have several samples.
Characters 14-15 of the barcode: 01 primary tumour, 02 recurrent tumour, 06 metastatic, 11 solid tissue normal.
TCGA gene-level RSEM expression, log2(norm_count + 1), stored genes x samples.
An environment file listing exact package versions so that code reruns identically later and elsewhere.
When samples from the same patient fall in both train and test sets, inflating performance. Prevent by splitting on patient_id.
float32 uses half the memory (4 vs 8 bytes per value); precision is ample for expression values.
